posts.name: Jeysie
posts.cooked:
So I didn't ask about what Idealist's personal project with Argent was because I figured it would come up during the whole initial backstory, and then it didn't and nobody else asked. Oops. What trouble are two of my fave characters getting up to?

And other people more or less asked my other questions for me. (Is Idealist fond of any geeky things other than Super Sentai and anime and tell us all the things about Caleb.)

With Mainstay and Medico's powers, it's less that I never thought to ask about them and more that "people get random powers from random radiation leakage" is such a stock bog standard power origin that it never occured to me to consider it as worth paying special note to within the context of everything else going on in the Sentinelsverse. And... well... kinda, TBH, even after listening to the explanation I'm still not sure I see it as other than "people get random powers from random radiation leakage". Sorry guys...

Idealist's origin is totally not what I was expecting, though. I feel even more protective of my precious psychic child now.

The whole stuff with the Void and with Voidsoul was downright creepy and weird, I approve. And look forward to the RPG Starter Kit even more now. And the Tactics timeline continues to suck a whole lot. A whole whole lot.

Also hands up if anyone else would totally listen to a Letters Page with C&A giving us blow by blows of Sentinel Comics comic book arcs.

posts.name: Chaosmancer
posts.cooked:
I honestly can't rememeber what Argent Adept Shenanigans you guys are talking about, could someone remind me?

 

Also, dang, just dang.

 

I vaguely remember that discussion about a healing hero (must have come during Rook City cause I joined around Shattered Timelines and I didn't get to see the original conversation taking place) and it is amazing to me that they were still adding elements as large as The SW Sentinels to the storyline that late. Though, it also helps explain why the SW Sentinels are so far removed from the rest of the storylines for as long as they were.

 

The Idealist being a clone... never would have guessed that in a million years, though now I'm even more curious about her mother. I really hope we get her showing up in the RPG, someone who can mix Science and MAgic like that has got to be a pretty dangerous individual.

 

Man, there is just so much to digest, I don't even know what to talk about. That was an intense amount of information to go through, and I note they foreshadowed something happening to the Reactor and didn't end up discussing it at the end of the episode. So, that might be a major thing in the RPG.
